Franco "dgt" Garcia (formerly known as fran-^ssj) (born May 12, 2001) is a Uruguayan professional Counter-Strike 2 player and a former Counter-Strike: Global Offensive player.

Trivia

[edit]
  • Was ranked the 10th best player of 2021 in Brazil by DRAFT5. [4]
  • Was elected the best rifler of 2022 in Brazil by Gamers Club. [5]
  • Was elected the best foreigner of 2022 in Brazil by Gamers Club. [6]

  • 2023-04-17 |  IEM Rio Major 2022: “Vivendo os melhores dias da minha vida”, diz dgt sobre Major do Brasil [IEM Rio Major 2022: “Living the best days of my life,” says dgt about Major from Brazil] by Bruno Martins of maisesports.com.br at Intel Extreme Masters Rio Major 2022
  • 2023-04-17 |  dgt sobre europeus: "É como colocar um time uruguaio para enfrentar o Liverpool" [dgt on Europeans: "It's like putting a Uruguayan team to face Liverpool"] by Roque Marques of Dust2.com.br at Intel Extreme Masters Rio 2023
  • 2024-01-23 |  CS2: “Meu corpo não respondia mais”, desabafou dgt após quase 10 horas de confronto [CS2: “My body wasn't responding anymore,” says dgt after almost 10 hours of confrontation] by Giulia Catarina of pichauarena.com.br at PGL Major Copenhagen 2024: South American Qualifier
  • 2024-06-04 |  dgt sobre 9z: "Poderia ter saído por dinheiro, mas tenho sonhos" [dgt on 9z: “I could have left for money, but I have dreams”] by gabrielpumba of dust2.com.br
  • 2024-08-23 | 9z dgt: “My dream is to win a big trophy with 9z and help them become a stable top-10 team.” by Leonardo Biazzi of esports.gg at BetBoom Dacha Belgrade 2024 #2
